observations.observation: At the initial scroll position, some lower city rows, roster entries, biography/reward-memory text, and the morning-courtyard action continue below the viewport. No blocking visual defect was found within indices 24-47. Emil and the remaining world residents are outside this assigned range and are covered by other reviewers. The diagnostic population of 108375 is fixture evidence; this image review does not certify natural progression, physical-device touch, or user art approval.
